translationRepairs: In the first month of spring in Tianshun one, at first light on renwu, Shi Heng, Marquis of Wuqing, Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu, regional commanders, Yang Shan, left censor-in-chief, Xu Youzhen, vice censor-in-chief, and the eunuch Cao Jixiang led troops to bring the Emperor out of the Southern Palace; he took the throne at Fengtian Gate and received the whole bureaucracy in audience.

In the first month of spring in Tianshun one, at first light on renwu, Shi Heng, Marquis of Wuqing, Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, regional commanders, Yang Shan, left censor-in-chief, Xu Youzhen, vice censor-in-chief, and the eunuch Cao Jixiang led troops to bring the Emperor out of the Southern Palace; he took the throne at Fengtian Gate and received the whole bureaucracy in audience.
s0002 has 都督張輗、張軏; 張輗 is Zhang Ni and 張軏 is Zhang Yue, so the idiomatic “Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu” swaps them and invents Fu.

In spring of the first year, first month, on the day renwu, at gray dawn, Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng, Regional Commanders Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Shan, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and Eunuch Cao Jixiang with troops welcomed the Emperor from the Southern Palace, held court at Fengtian Gate, and the hundred officials attended.

In spring of the first year, first month, on the day renwu, at gray dawn, Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng, Regional Commanders Zhang Ni and Zhang Yue, Left Censor-in-chief Yang Shan, Vice Censor-in-chief Xu Youzhen, and Eunuch Cao Jixiang with troops welcomed the Emperor from the Southern Palace, held court at Fengtian Gate, and the hundred officials attended.
s0002 has 都督張輗、張軏; the literal “Zhang Yue and Zhang Fu” misassigns 張輗 and invents Fu for 張軏.

Rewards were fixed for the Gate-Seizing restoration: Shi Heng became Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Fu, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Yue, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made vice commissioner-in-chief.

s0008 has 張軏太平侯，張輗文安伯; Zhang Yue received Taiping and Zhang Ni Wen’an, so the idiomatic names are reversed/wrong.

Merit in the Gate-Seizing restoration was discussed and rewarded: Shi Heng was enfeoffed Duke of Loyal States; Zhang Fu, Marquis of Taiping; Zhang Yue, Baron of Wen'an; Yang Shan, Baron of Xingji; and Cao Jixiang's adopted son Qin was made Vice Commissioner-in-chief.

s0008 has 張軏太平侯，張輗文安伯; the literal misnames both enfeoffees.
